finding: The strongest current separate-feature counterhypothesis should not be represented by a second 2B-scale multimodal model. MobileCLIP2-S0 and DINOv3-S/16 provide much smaller/specialized adversarial baselines: MobileCLIP2-S0 publishes an 11.4M-parameter image encoder and mobile image latency; DINOv3 exposes frozen dense patch features usable with kNN/linear probes.
why_qwen_embedding_is_not_default_counte: The official Qwen3-VL-Embedding family starts at 2B and is designed as a full retrieval model. It is useful evidence that retrieval geometry needs training, but it violates the intended tiny-MVC resource posture as the first duplicate encoder baseline.
